summary: Infer and apply an evidence-based written voice across contexts while preserving meaning, attribution, and register distinctions.
triggers: infer a project voice from authorized writing samples
adapt this draft to our brand or team voice across audiences
calibrate recurring writing traits and context-specific registers
compare conflicting voice examples before drafting
antiTriggers: one-off tone adjustment with no sample-based profile needed
deceptive imitation or false attribution of a real person
speech synthesis, voice cloning, or likeness generation
send or publish a draft without a named target and authority
